symptoms: chest pain chest pressure chest tightness shortness of breath breathlessness pain during walking pain during exercise left arm pain jaw pain sweating palpitations
reason: Chest discomfort with shortness of breath or exertional symptoms can involve the heart and should be evaluated by a heart specialist.
red_flags: chest pain with shortness of breath, crushing chest pressure, fainting, sweating, pain spreading to arm or jaw

symptoms: face drooping arm weakness speech difficulty slurred speech sudden confusion sudden vision loss sudden severe headache one sided weakness numbness trouble walking
reason: Sudden weakness, speech difficulty, or facial drooping can be signs of stroke and need emergency evaluation immediately.
red_flags: face drooping, arm weakness, speech trouble, sudden one-sided numbness, sudden severe headache

symptoms: wheezing cough shortness of breath asthma breathing difficulty chest tightness cough at night breathing problem after exercise
reason: Wheezing, asthma-like symptoms, and recurring breathing difficulty are commonly evaluated by a lung specialist.
red_flags: severe breathing difficulty, blue lips, inability to speak full sentences, chest pain with breathing trouble

symptoms: skin rash itching redness hives dry skin eczema acne pimples skin allergy patches swelling skin irritation
reason: Rashes, itching, acne, eczema-like symptoms, and skin irritation are usually evaluated by a skin specialist.
red_flags: rash with breathing difficulty, rapidly spreading rash, fever with rash, swelling of lips or face

symptoms: stomach pain abdominal pain acidity heartburn vomiting nausea bloating constipation diarrhea indigestion gastric reflux burning stomach
reason: Persistent stomach pain, acidity, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, or reflux symptoms are commonly handled by a digestive system specialist.
red_flags: vomiting blood, black stools, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, unexplained weight loss

symptoms: back pain neck pain knee pain shoulder pain joint pain fracture sprain bone pain muscle injury sports injury difficulty walking
reason: Bone, joint, back, neck, fracture, sprain, and movement-related problems are commonly evaluated by an orthopedic specialist.
red_flags: loss of bladder control with back pain, severe injury, visible deformity, inability to walk

symptoms: joint swelling morning stiffness arthritis multiple joint pain autoimmune pain swollen fingers chronic joint inflammation
reason: Multiple swollen or stiff joints, especially morning stiffness, can suggest inflammatory or autoimmune joint conditions.
red_flags: severe swelling with fever, sudden hot painful joint, inability to move joint

symptoms: excessive thirst frequent urination unexplained weight loss diabetes high sugar low sugar thyroid weight gain weight loss heat intolerance cold intolerance
reason: Diabetes symptoms, thyroid symptoms, and hormone-related problems are commonly evaluated by an endocrinologist.
red_flags: confusion with very high sugar, fainting, severe dehydration, very low sugar symptoms

symptoms: burning urination frequent urination urine pain blood in urine kidney stone groin pain prostate urinary infection bladder pain
reason: Urinary burning, blood in urine, kidney stone symptoms, bladder pain, or prostate-related symptoms are commonly evaluated by a urologist.
red_flags: fever with flank pain, inability to urinate, severe kidney stone pain, blood in urine

symptoms: irregular periods menstrual pain heavy bleeding vaginal discharge pelvic pain pregnancy contraception pcos fertility women health
reason: Irregular periods, pelvic pain, PCOS, fertility, contraception, and other women’s health concerns are commonly evaluated by a gynecologist.
red_flags: heavy bleeding with dizziness, severe pelvic pain, pregnancy with bleeding, pregnancy with severe abdominal pain

symptoms: child fever baby fever infant cough child vomiting child diarrhea child rash pediatric vaccination child not eating
reason: Health problems in babies, children, and adolescents are commonly handled by a pediatrician.
red_flags: baby under 3 months with fever, difficulty breathing, dehydration, seizure, child unusually sleepy

symptoms: ear pain throat pain sore throat sinus blocked nose runny nose hearing loss tonsils voice change nose bleeding dizziness vertigo
reason: Ear, nose, throat, sinus, tonsil, hearing, and voice-related symptoms are commonly evaluated by an ENT specialist.
red_flags: difficulty breathing, severe throat swelling, sudden hearing loss, heavy nose bleeding

symptoms: eye pain red eye blurry vision vision loss itchy eyes watery eyes eye infection headache with vision eye injury
reason: Eye pain, red eye, vision changes, eye infections, and eye injuries should be evaluated by an eye specialist.
red_flags: sudden vision loss, severe eye pain, eye injury, flashes of light with vision loss

symptoms: anxiety panic attacks depression sadness stress insomnia mood swings hopelessness fear racing thoughts mental health
reason: Anxiety, depression, panic attacks, sleep problems, and mood concerns can be evaluated by a mental health specialist.
red_flags: suicidal thoughts, self harm thoughts, thoughts of harming others, severe confusion

symptoms: tooth pain toothache gum pain bleeding gums cavity dental pain bad breath swollen gums wisdom tooth jaw pain while chewing
reason: Tooth pain, gum problems, cavities, wisdom tooth issues, and dental infections are commonly handled by a dentist.
red_flags: facial swelling, fever with tooth infection, difficulty swallowing, difficulty breathing

symptoms: allergic reaction hives swelling lips swelling face breathing difficulty after food after medicine anaphylaxis severe allergy
reason: Allergic reactions with facial swelling or breathing difficulty can be life-threatening and need emergency care.
red_flags: breathing difficulty, swelling of lips or tongue, fainting, widespread hives after food or medicine

symptoms: headache migraine severe headache dizziness numbness tingling seizures fainting memory problems tremors nerve pain
reason: Migraines, seizures, nerve pain, numbness, dizziness, and neurological symptoms are commonly evaluated by a neurologist.
red_flags: sudden worst headache, headache with weakness, seizure, confusion, head injury

symptoms: kidney problem swelling legs foamy urine high creatinine reduced urine kidney disease protein urine high blood pressure kidney
reason: Kidney function problems, foamy urine, swelling, reduced urination, or high creatinine are commonly evaluated by a kidney specialist.
red_flags: very low urine output, severe swelling with breathing difficulty, confusion, severe weakness

symptoms: fever cold cough flu body ache sore throat mild headache tiredness viral infection common cold
reason: Common fever, cold, cough, body ache, and mild flu-like symptoms can usually start with a general physician.
red_flags: very high fever, breathing difficulty, confusion, chest pain, dehydration

symptoms: severe bleeding uncontrolled bleeding deep wound accident trauma head injury unconscious fainting severe burn
reason: Severe bleeding, major injury, loss of consciousness, or serious trauma requires emergency medical attention.
red_flags: uncontrolled bleeding, unconsciousness, severe head injury, severe burn, major accident
